description: Send a free fax to a US or Canada number (no account required). Limited to 3 pages total and 2 sends per email/IP per day. Returns a job_id immediately, but the fax does NOT send until the sender clicks a confirmation link emailed to sender_email. The daily-limit check happens at click time, not at submission — a submitted fax may still be rejected if the limit is hit by then; the agent can detect this by calling check_fax_status after the user reports clicking the link. If the document exceeds the free page limit, the response will suggest using purchase_credits to buy a prepaid account. Files go in files (base64-encoded content) or attachments (links; how ChatGPT passes files the user attached).

attachments.description: Files passed by link instead of content. ChatGPT fills this in with files the user attached to the conversation; any other client may give https links. Same formats as files, and files and attachments together count toward the file limit.

file_id.description: The app's id for the file

mime_type.description: The file's media type, for example application/pdf

fax_number.description: Destination fax number (10 digits, US or Canada).

files.description: Up to 3 files. Each must be base64-encoded. Free faxes are limited to 3 pages total across text + files.

sender_email.description: Sender's email address. A confirmation link will be sent here; the fax does NOT actually send until the user clicks that link.

text.description: Fax body text. Either text, files or attachments must be provided.

name: send_free_fax
title: Send Free Fax
